name: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd.
about: GE Vernova T&D India Limited engages in power transmission and distribution business in India and internationally. It offers grid solutions for generation, transmission, distribution, and industries and infrastructures, such as HVDC/FACTS, AC substations solution and services for system integration; HV/MV equipment, including circuit breakers, disconnectors, instrument transformers, power transformers, capacitors, and reactors; and automation protection comprising digital substations, asset performance and energy management. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~29% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~25% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 76 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 154), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 76 vs sector median 46; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 29, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2024, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 130% a year while PE moved 192 → 76.
